entries.title: A reply that asks for work shows the work as it happens
entries.body: When you reply under a crewmate's card and ask for a change, the thread now shows what the crewmate is doing on it, step by step, beside "working". For work that takes more than a few minutes, the crewmate first says in one line what it is doing, and its full answer still follows when the work is done.

picture.alt: A card's thread with your reply asking to rename review to audit, the crewmate's line "Renaming review to audit now", and under it "working" beside "Rename review to audit across the app"
